sources.title: DeepSeek Coder:
sources.snippet: DeepSeek Coder comprises a series of code language models trained from scratch on both 87% code and 13% natural language in English and Chinese, with each model pre-trained on 2T tokens.

sources.title: GitHub - kortix-ai/fast-apply
sources.snippet: We chose smaller models (7B and 1.5B) for fast inference speed, suitable for instant apply tasks. These models work well with AI-powered code editors like Aider, PearAI or local tools to reduce the cost of frontier model output.
